column2: [intro]
I woke up one morning, all confused,
I searched for my alarm, but it was lost and abused.
I had replaced it with a trumpet blast,
To make sure I’d wake up with a festive cast.
In my life, everything’s like a movie scene,
I only tidy things up in the reel, it seems.
I’m the king of wacky scripts and tales,
The wildest stories, that's where my virtue prevails.
One day, I searched my pockets for my keys,
They vanished like a scene from a comedy spree.
But I found them stuck in the door,
I’m not so skilled, that's for sure.
